summary.text: Myriad Destruction Lightning Forest is a myriad tribulation of millions of lightning bolts gathered like a forest.

claims.text: Fang Yuan uses unrestrained heavenly mark and quickly refines three heaven path dao marks. Heaven’s will is infuriated. The dao marks, originally scattered, gather together. Thunder rumbles, lightning roars, dark clouds form, and wild winds blow. In a few breaths a tribulation forms. Earth shakes, mountains rumble, and lightning flashes and shatters rocks. Lightning clouds continue to form and spread, from a hundred li to over a hundred thousand li. The formed tribulation is Myriad Destruction Lightning Forest. It is not an earthly calamity, a heavenly tribulation, or a grand tribulation. Only a rank eight Gu Immortal could face it, and such tribulations put fear into most rank eight Gu Immortals.

The Heavenly Dao seeks to balance deficit and surplus. Mini Southern Border is the most developed area in the sovereign immortal aperture, so this myriad tribulation targets it. Fang Yuan had skipped myriad tribulations by annexing grotto-heavens with the sovereign immortal aperture, so he had not gone through a single myriad tribulation. Cloud Bamboo Mountain is broken apart. Eight desolate beast cloud foxes and eleven desolate plant spear tip bamboos on that mountain are wiped out. Fang Yuan cannot act freely, because heaven path dao marks still restrict each of his actions. He sends Combat Beast King, the sole rank eight from annexed Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, and hands him a rank eight star sea snail corpse. Combat Beast King turns into a giant covered in starlight armor. Combined lightning bolts, under heaven’s will, halt the giant. Heaven path dao marks are densely gathered, so heaven’s will is produced, and that will makes the tribulation adaptive.

After a short while Mini Southern Border has already lost many resource points. Even if Fang Yuan gave up a portion of his immortal aperture, he could not break free, because the heaven path dao marks that created the tribulation can move around. He has to endure it forcefully.

Mini Southern Border is ravaged to a pitiful level: countless mountains collapse and the earth cracks. Combat Beast King is bathed in blood as he fights. The range expands again while Fang Yuan’s main body is drawn into the fight outside. Fang Yuan looks at the heaven path dao marks that transformed into lightning path and cloud path to create this myriad tribulation. This current tribulation is created by the three thousand heaven path dao marks in his body, a way of forming that is extremely rare even in the long history of humanity. Myriad destruction lightning forest also appears in Mini Central Continent and attacks the human path formation that uses the thousand wish tree as its core. Fang Yuan sends soul beasts kept in Mini Black Heaven to draw fire. They are extremely fragile under the myriad tribulation. In a short time a hundred desolate level soul beasts perish, and more than ten ancient soul beasts die as well.

Fang Yuan sacrifices the soul beast group so they bear the brunt and draw heaven’s will’s attention. He activates the human path formation. A grand white light pillar shoots into the lightning clouds, and the lightning clouds freeze. Combat Beast King scatters Gu worms in the sky, and Fang Yuan sets up a formation. Combat Beast King intercepts the returning lightning bolts. After over ten breaths his star armor shatters and he falls unconscious. The formation becomes a huge basin that absorbs the lightning bolts into a pool of lightning plasma. That pool bears the brunt of this myriad destruction lightning forest tribulation, more effectively than Combat Beast King. Its core is a rank eight Immortal Gu Fang Yuan had, Lightning Gu. The plasma seems to be lightning path dao marks, but it is actually formed from a small portion of those three thousand heaven path dao marks. Fang Yuan uses unrestrained heavenly mark on the plasma and refines dao marks much faster. Heaven’s will then stops this form and changes the tribulation. For ordinary myriad tribulations, the content is fixed once it appears. Fang Yuan’s myriad tribulation is special: it is made of over three thousand heaven path dao marks, and heaven’s will can change its forms at will.

Against the initial myriad tribulation, myriad destruction lightning forest, Fang Yuan came up with a countermeasure after great effort. Heaven’s will’s manipulation made the heaven path dao marks change the tribulation, so that method became ineffective. Inside the sovereign immortal aperture the myriad tribulation has already turned into a torrential flood.

Copper Seal Mountain in Mini Southern Border is formed entirely from copper, with no soil. It is heavily targeted by the myriad tribulation myriad destruction lightning forest. Half of the mountain is destroyed and charred, giving out dense smoke and sparks. The entire mountain turns into a molten state and emits a terrible smell. Lightning bolts destroy mountains.
